_comment: Draft Conversation Schema for branch context. Field names mirror the participant data keys set by the Initialise task so a later switch is a rename-free change. Create via Admin > Custom Data Management > Conversation Schemas (or the Conversation Schema Management API) only when native Scripter/Analytics support is available or an org standard requires it.
